summary.en: US markets eye a busy earnings week with Big Tech names and AI chip makers leading premarket gains. Middle East diplomacy offers relief to oil prices while investors await the Fed's rate decision.
summary.zh: 美股关注盈利周，大科技公司和 AI 芯片股领涨盘前。中东外交关系为油价提供缓解，投资者等待美联储利率决策。

title.en: Broadcom and Nvidia Rise on Anthropic and Meta AI Deals
title.zh: 博通和英伟德因 Anthropic 和 Meta AI 交易而上涨

impact.en: $63B financing deal for Anthropic's AI compute needs boosts Broadcom, while Nvidia invests $3B in Meta equity.
impact.zh: Anthropic AI 计算需求的$630 亿融资协议提振博通，英伟德投资$30 亿用于 Meta 股权。

macroRisk.en: Heavy AI capex could strain corporate balance sheets if cash flows don't keep pace.
macroRisk.zh: 大量 AI 资本支出可能在现金流跟不上时挤压公司资产负债表。

title.en: Fed Rate Decision on the Agenda
title.zh: 美联储利率决策在议程上

impact.en: Central bank convenes two-day meeting to determine next rate move, with markets pricing in varied outcomes.
impact.zh: 央行召开两天会议确定下一步利率行动，市场定价各种结果。

macroRisk.en: Unexpected hawkish pivot could trigger flight to safety and equity sell-off.
macroRisk.zh: 意外的鹰派转向可能触发避险和股市抛售。

title.en: Oil Prices Edge Lower on Diplomatic Progress
title.zh: 油价在中东外交进展中略有下跌

impact.en: Talks between Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan and Iran provide relief amid Middle East tensions.
impact.zh: 沙特、土耳其、巴基斯坦和伊朗之间的会谈在地缘紧张局势下提供缓解。

macroRisk.en: Sustained oil declines could signal deflationary pressures but also recession risk.
macroRisk.zh: 持续的油价下跌可能表明通缩压力但也暗示衰退风险。

title.en: Big Tech Earnings Start the Week
title.zh: 大科技股盈利开启本周

impact.en: Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet expected to report, testing whether AI boom can sustain amid broader market volatility.
impact.zh: 预期亚马逊、微软和谷歌报告，测试在广泛市场波动中 AI 繁荣能否持续。

macroRisk.en: Tech earnings miss could cascade through index and trigger rotation into value.
macroRisk.zh: 科技股盈利不及预期可能通过指数传导并触发向价值股的轮动。

title.en: S&P Futures Gain 0.3% Ahead of Earnings
title.zh: 标普期货在盈利前上涨 0.3%

impact.en: Wall Street opens positive as investors focus on AI chip demand and Fed policy clarity.
impact.zh: 华尔街以正面开盘，投资者关注 AI 芯片需求和美联储政策清晰度。

macroRisk.en: Positive start could evaporate if macro data disappoints.
macroRisk.zh: 积极开局可能在宏观数据令人失望时蒸发。

ai.en: AI chip makers lead gains on Anthropic/Meta deals. Data center demand remains strong with enterprise AI adoption accelerating.
ai.zh: AI 芯片制造商因 Anthropic/Meta 交易领涨。数据中心需求保持强劲，企业 AI 采用加速。

semiconductor.en: Mixed signals as consumer chip demand normalizes while AI segments outperform. NVDA, AMD, AVGO benefit from infrastructure build.
semiconductor.zh: 信号不一，消费者芯片需求正常化而 AI 板块表现强劲。NVDA、AMD、AVGO 受益于基础设施建设。

bigTech.en: Earnings ahead offer clarity. Cloud and AI services provide growth offsetting advertising headwinds in macro-sensitive names.
bigTech.zh: 盈利提供清晰度。云和 AI 服务提供增长抵消宏观敏感名称的广告逆风。

energy.en: Pressure eases on diplomatic progress. Oil sector faces sell-off risk if geopolitical tensions de-escalate too quickly.
energy.zh: 外交进展缓解压力。如果地缘紧张局势过快降级，能源股面临抛售风险。

ev.en: EV demand continues but pricing wars persist. China EV export dynamics and tariff policy remain key catalysts to watch.
ev.zh: 电动车需求继续但价格战持续。中国电动车出口动态和关税政策是关键催化剂。

market.en: Mixed with tech-led gains offsetting broader uncertainty. Defensive sectors may outperform if inflation surprises rise.
market.zh: 科技股领涨抵消更广泛不确定性，如果通胀意外上升防御性板块可能跑赢大盘。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver hold as Fed meeting looms. Central bank buying supports prices but safe-haven demand remains the key driver.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价在美联储会议前夕保持稳定。央行购买支撑价格但避险需求仍是主要驱动力。

oil.en: WTI near $70-72/bbl range. Diplomatic efforts to ease Middle East tensions provide relief but supply remains under OPEC+ control.
oil.zh: WTI 在$70-72/桶附近。中东紧张局势外交努力提供缓解但供应仍受 OPEC+控制。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures +0.3%, Nasdaq leading with AI chip makers. Dow mixed as energy lags but financials hold.
futures.zh: 标普期货上涨 0.3%，纳斯达克由 AI 芯片股领涨，道指不一因能源滞后但金融股保持。

treasury10Y.en: Yields around 4.0-4.1% ahead of Fed meeting, pricing in potential policy shift from the two-day FOMC session.
treasury10Y.zh: 收益率在 4.0-4.1% 左右，对两天联邦公开市场委员会会议定价潜在政策转变。

dxy.en: Dollar stable near 105-106 as geopolitical headlines provide mixed signals on risk sentiment.
dxy.zh: 美元在 105-106 稳定，地缘政治头条对风险情绪提供混合信号。

oil.en: WTI oil trading in $70-73/bbl range, Brent near $77 as diplomatic progress on Middle East tensions moderates prices.
oil.zh: WTI 原油在$70-73/桶交易，布伦特接近$77，中东紧张局势外交进展缓和价格。

keyRisk.en: Fed policy clarity needed; prolonged uncertainty could cause volatility and rotation into defensive sectors.
keyRisk.zh: 需要美联储政策清晰度，长期不确定性可能引起波动并转向防御性板块。

note.en: Markets navigate earnings uncertainty and Fed meeting with tech strength supporting broader indices but macro risks from geopolitics and inflation keeping volatility elevated.
note.zh: 市场在盈利不确定性和美联储会议间航行，科技股强度支撑更广泛指数但地缘政治和通胀的宏观风险使波动性保持高位。
